blocks.prompt: 18. If \(\tan^{-1} x + \tan^{-1} y + \tan^{-1} z = \pi\), then show that \(x + y + z = xyz\).
blocks.explanation:
Yahan teen inverse tangents ka jama \(\pi\) diya hai, aur humein is se \(x, y, z\) ka ek seedha algebraic rishta nikalna hai.
Diya kya hai? \(\tan^{-1} x + \tan^{-1} y + \tan^{-1} z = \pi\). Dikhana kya hai? \(x + y + z = xyz\).
Rule kaunsa? Angles ke naam, phir dono sides ka tan, Remember box ke \(\tan(\alpha + \beta)\) formula se.
Plan: ek angle ko doosri taraf le jana, tan lena, aur cross-multiply. Formula (v) yahan istemal nahi karenge; wajah neeche hai.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(\tan^{-1} x + \tan^{-1} y + \tan^{-1} z = \pi\).
Dikhana hai: \(x + y + z = xyz\).
Tareeqa: Dono sides ka tan lenge. Formula (v) is liye nahi ke woh \(xy < 1\) mangta hai, jabke yahan \(\alpha + \beta = \pi - \gamma\) \(\frac{\pi}{2}\) se bara hai, jis ka matlab \(xy > 1\) hai. Tan lene wala tareeqa har haal mein chalta hai.

Angles ke naam
\[\tan^{-1} x = \alpha,\ \tan^{-1} y = \beta\]
\[\tan^{-1} z = \gamma\]
\[\tan\alpha = x,\ \tan\beta = y,\ \tan\gamma = z\]
Kyun: \(\tan^{-1}\) ki definition. Teeno angles \(\left(-\frac{\pi}{2}, \frac{\pi}{2}\right)\) mein hain.

Shart ko nayi shakal dein
\[\alpha + \beta + \gamma = \pi\]
\[\alpha + \beta = \pi - \gamma\]
Kyun: Dono taraf se \(\gamma\) minus kiya, taake ek taraf do angles ka jama ho, jis ka tan formula humein aata hai.

Dono sides ka tan lein
\[\tan(\alpha + \beta) = \tan(\pi - \gamma)\]
\[\dfrac{\tan\alpha + \tan\beta}{1 - \tan\alpha\tan\beta} = -\tan\gamma\]
\[\dfrac{x + y}{1 - xy} = -z\]
Kyun: Left par Remember box ka formula; right par \(\tan(\pi - \gamma) = -\tan\gamma\), kyunke doosre quadrant mein tan negative hota hai. Phir \(\tan\alpha, \tan\beta, \tan\gamma\) ki jagah \(x, y, z\) rakhe. \(xy = 1\) nahi ho sakta: warna \(\alpha + \beta = \pm\frac{\pi}{2}\) hota aur \(\gamma\) \(\frac{\pi}{2}\) ya \(\frac{3\pi}{2}\) banta, jo \(\tan^{-1}\) ki range mein mumkin nahi.
Dhyan dein: \(\tan(\pi - \gamma)\) ko \(+\tan\gamma\) likhna aam ghalti hai.

Cross-multiply karein
\[x + y = -z(1 - xy)\]
\[x + y = -z + xyz\]
\[x + y + z = xyz\]
Kyun: Dono sides ko \(1 - xy\) se multiply kiya (jo zero nahi), bracket khola, aur \(-z\) ko left par le aaye to woh \(+z\) ban gaya.

Tasdeeq
\[x = 1,\ y = 2,\ z = 3\]
\[\tan^{-1} 1 + \tan^{-1} 2 + \tan^{-1} 3\]
\[\approx 0.7854 + 1.1071 + 1.2490 = \pi\]
\[1 + 2 + 3 = 6 = 1 \cdot 2 \cdot 3\]
Kyun: Yeh teen numbers shart poori karte hain (jama \(\approx 3.1416\)), aur natija bhi: jama 6 aur product bhi 6. Ek khoobsurat misaal jo yaad rakhne layak hai.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text: Kitab mein Exercise 9.2 ke jawab chhape hue nahi hain. Is page ka har hal hamara apna hai: qadam ba qadam kiya gaya, computer algebra system (sympy) se alag se check kiya gaya, aur ek solution book se bhi milaya gaya. Is liye aap apna proof yahan wale proof se mila kar dekh sakte hain; agar aap ka tareeqa alag hai magar har qadam ki wajah sahi hai, to woh bhi theek hai.
